summary.text: Marty Murray is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 78, an office he has held since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as senior project manager and says he has also worked as an adjunct professor at Harris Stowe State University.

paragraphs.text: Marty Murray was born in Chicago, Illinois, and earned a bachelor's degree from Southern Illinois University, Carbondale and a graduate degree from the University of Missouri.
Ballotpedia says his career experience includes working as a senior project manager and as an adjunct professor at Harris Stowe State University.
Murray assumed office on January 8, 2025, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Administration and Accounts Committee, the Budget Committee and the Financial Institutions Committee.
